'''Birn Da'p''' was a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to [[Lologin Da'p]]. The pair were veteran holidaymakers, and traveled aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] when it was [[Attack on the Kuari Princess|attacked]] by the [[Riders of the Maelstrom]].
